questions.explanation: CSS stands for Cascading Style Sheets, used for styling web pages.

questions.text: Which CSS property changes text color?
questions.explanation: The 'color' property is used to change text color in CSS.

questions.text: How do you select an element with id 'header'?
questions.explanation: Use # followed by the id name to select an element by id.

questions.text: Which property is used to change the background color?
questions.explanation: The 'background-color' property sets the background color of an element.

questions.text: How do you make text bold in CSS?
questions.explanation: Use 'font-weight: bold' to make text bold in CSS.

questions.text: Which property adds space inside an element's border?
questions.explanation: Padding adds space inside an element's border, between the border and content.

questions.text:
How do you select all

elements?
questions.explanation: Use the element name directly to select all elements of that type.

questions.text: Which property is used to change text alignment?
questions.explanation: The 'text-align' property controls horizontal text alignment.

questions.text: What is the correct CSS syntax?
questions.explanation: CSS syntax is: selector { property: value; }

questions.text: Which property controls the font size?
questions.explanation: The 'font-size' property controls the size of text.

questions.text: How do you select elements with class 'menu'?
questions.explanation: Use a dot (.) followed by the class name to select elements by class.

questions.text: Which property adds space outside an element's border?
questions.explanation: Margin adds space outside an element's border, between elements.
